reply.headline: Typical rain, temperature, snow and wind for Nepal–Tibet border area on 26 Aug 2026.
why: Recent rain over the last 6 days was 66 mm, and days like this happen about 18 times a year here now.
Rain over the last 6 days was about as common here as in 1951–1980, when it happened about 19 times a year.
Feels-like highs of up to 30 °C happen about 68 times a year now, which is 3.2 times more common here than in 1951–1980.
reply.what_it_means: The checks do not cover thunderstorms, hail, freezing rain or ice, wildfire, air quality, coastal flooding, or geological hazards.
